articles.title: France orders country's internet service providers to block Polymarket
articles.snippet: The regulator cited concerns over addictive mechanics, a lack of self-exclusion tools, and a high volume of French users bypassing previous financial restrictions.

articles.title: DOG Mode explains Bitcoin's next governance fight
articles.snippet: Leonidas' DOG Mode client challenges Bitcoin's default relay policies, reopening a philosophical debate over censorship, free markets and who really governs the network.

articles.title: Polymarket traders cut Clarity Act passage odds to record low as Senate delay drags on
articles.snippet: Polymarket bettors have cut the odds of the CLARITY Act passing this year to a record low as Senate negotiations over ethics provisions remain unresolved.

articles.title: French gambling regulator orders ISPs to block Polymarket
articles.snippet: Autorité nationale des jeux has ordered France’s internet service providers to geoblock Polymarket, citing illegal gambling and market manipulation concerns.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth will erode bank deposits, says ECB’s Cipollone
articles.snippet: ECB’s Piero Cipollone said stablecoin adoption could erode bank deposits, but the digital euro will keep banks at the center of payments.
